designationHistory.name: Kenai National Moose Range
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Kenai National Moose Range on Alaska's Kenai Peninsula by Executive Order 8979 to protect the breeding and feeding range of the Kenai moose.
designationHistory.note: The FWS document says ANILCA (1980) later changed the name to Kenai National Wildlife Refuge and modified boundaries and purposes; that second step was not independently verified here.
